integrity: Full incidence representatives, exhaustive labelled classification code, and exact Smith/determinant verification code are embedded.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite integer computation; the Pappus critical-group row was already published by Joyner and Melles (2017, section 5.18). The substantive new determination is for the two non-Pappus classes; possible unindexed prior tables remain a risk.
title: Critical-group fingerprints of all three \((9_3)\) Levi graphs
